notes: Both full papers were examined and reference titles verified. Original text acquired from https://kar.kent.ac.uk/45135/1/Yang%20Stoeber%20Wang%20%282015%29%20PAID.pdf . Replication used the frozen parent-supplied parse. Input repeats a broad description within each original study and supplies no effect-specific predictor/outcome or replication model. Multiple eligible tests remain, so no table cell was assigned using audit ID or input order. Numeric fields are null because the target test cannot be uniquely matched; neither paper is unavailable. The reported_success value records the authors' overall paper-level narrative verdict only, not an identified individual-effect verdict.
